topic: RC fuel systems: fuel/oil densities, consumption, tank sizing and placement, CG shift with fuel burn, simulator tank models (glow, gasoline premix, kerosene turbine)
note: Guide: docs/research/fuel-systems/FUEL-00/README.md section 6. All 29 local hashes re-verified 2026-10-19. Local copies live in the gitignored references/rc-fuel-systems/ (reference only, do not redistribute). 'existing' entries were already present elsewhere under references/ and were re-read, not re-downloaded. Evidence kinds: manufacturer = manufacturer-stated; measured = instrumented test; standard = specification/table; derived = computed here; rule_of_thumb = hobby practice.

existing_local.use: Balance 'ready to fly and an empty fuel tank' (p.43); 12 oz tank for .61-.91 2T / .91-1.20 4T; 'vibration may cause your fuel to foam, which will ... cause your engine to run lean or quit'.
16-24 oz tank for 30-45 cc glow / 30-60 cc gas; balance with 'all parts of the model installed (ready to fly) and an empty fuel tank'; same foam quote.
Counter-example: CG 171 mm (165-178) 'ready for flight' without fuel state.
32 oz (or larger) tank; 'carb has a strong pump, so the tank can be mounted almost anywhere'; vented tank, free clunk; Red Line 40:1 or Motul 800 50:1.
EFI calibrated on Red Line All Sport 40:1; external fuel pump.
30:1; vented (unpressurized) tank with vent extension up and rearward to avoid draining nose-down.

Idle/max ml/min: P20-SX 12/90, P60-SE 70/240, P80-SE 95/275, P100-RX 80/390, P160-RXi-B 120/510, P200-RX 129/730, P220-RXi 130/725; kg/min columns imply 0.80 kg/L; SFC 0.150-0.188 kg/(N h); P20-SX recommended tank 550-800 ml. STP 15 C, 1013 mbar, +-3 %.
p.11: keep suction-side hose as short as possible (strong vacuum -> cavitation bubbles -> flameout); pressure side uncritical.

web.values: Methanol 0.7914 at 20 C (DOE PAC); 0.8100 at 0 C / 0.7866 at 25 C (Merck Index via HSDB); 0.792 at 68 F (USCG CHRIS).
Nitromethane 1.1371 g/cm3 at 20 C (CRC Handbook 94th ed. via HSDB); 1.139 at 68 F (USCG CHRIS); bulk 9.5 lb/gal (Hawley). No temperature series retrieved.
Castor oil USP specific gravity 0.957-0.961 at 25 C (distributor copy of USP limits; not downloaded).
UCON LB (water-insoluble PAG) grades: SG 20/20 C 0.997 (LB-400-X), 0.999 (LB-650-X), 1.000 (LB-650-XY23), 1.006 (LB-1800-XY26). Proxy for synthetic glow oil; LB-165 itself not found.
Mobil Jet Oil II density 1.0035 kg/L at 15 C (ASTM D4052).
Jet A-1 775-840 kg/m3 at 15 C; already in repo AV-18 R13.
Motul 800 2T Road Racing 0.926 at 20 C; Off Road 0.911 (retailer copies of Motul TDS).
Compiled from Desert Aircraft: DA-100 71 g/min @ 6000 rpm, 7.31 kW, 2.63 kg; DA-150 93.5 g/min @ 6000 rpm, 12.3 kW, 3.61 kg. Already in repo 05-propulsion (DA-100).
DA-170: 4 oz/min at 6000 rpm (~118 ml/min). Already cited in repo 05-propulsion.
121 cc, 11.7 hp, 2.25 kg, 1300-6900 rpm; no consumption.
50 cc, 4.95 hp, 1.42 kg, 1600-7000 rpm; no consumption.
Horn 2015 AFIT MS (109 MB, not downloaded): 28/55/85 cm3 2T gasoline, fuel conversion efficiency at peak power 14.9/15.4/18.3 %; EFI conversion of the 55 cc cut BSFC significantly.
Sullivan slant 24 oz 60x76x181 mm; 16 oz 59x68x146 mm (retailer copy of spec); 14 oz 52x67x146 mm (horizonhobby.com SUL442). No empty masses.
Du-Bro 10 oz 57x65x124 mm; 24 oz 64x78x191 mm (DUB424). Retailer PB Tech: 40 oz 83x102x203 mm 178 g; 50 oz 89x111x213 mm 186 g.
Retailer UAT sizes 130, 250, 280 ml; function: trap air before the pump.
